caption: Table 2. DFU class requests
rows: Requests the device to leave DFU mode and enter the application.
Requests data transfer from Host to the device in order to load them into device internal flash memory. Includes also erase commands.
Requests data transfer from device to Host in order to load content of device internal flash memory into a Host file.
Requests device to send status report to the Host (including status resulting from the last request execution and the state the device enters immediately after this request).
Requests device to clear error status and move to next step.
Requests the device to send only the state it enters immediately after this request.
Requests device to exit the current state/operation and enter idle state immediately.

2. Not applicable (this operation is allowed, but has no meaning as the memory is not protected).
3. In this case, both the flash memory (from 0x0800 0000) and the RAM are erased. The option byte area is reset to the default values.
